name: wali-mgu-datalog
description: An independent datalogging and map-switching app for tuned BMW vehicles, running on the MGU (iDrive 7/8) head unit. Built from scratch; contains no third-party app code and no BMW SDK.
author: TunedByWali

scripts.preview: npm run bundle && node -e "console.log('Open runtime/web/index.html in a browser')"
scripts.build:app: python3 kit/tools/build.py wali_datalog && python3 kit/tools/build.py --hmi ID8 wali_datalog
